appearances.snippet: my old tweet saying that I had a source inside of the French government because I did that told me that their GIGN intervention group was involved in the assassination. I said that Charlie Kirk's assassin trained with the. ... The French Legion 13th Brigade with multi-state involvement.

verification.notes: Current official French material confirms that the 2nd Foreign Infantry Regiment trained with U.S. Marines in California in August 2025, not that Tyler Robinson or another Kirk assassin trained with the 13th Demi-Brigade. No source corroborates the alleged assassin-training or multi-state operation.
